t01.rationale: Defines the integer-list parser and its delimiter handling; this is the production source scope for signed token parsing.

t02.rationale: Defines soft_sorted and its first, middle, and last partitions; this is the production scope for overlap ownership.

t03.rationale: Defines OrderedSet.index, fancy lookup, and the two lookup aliases; these API definitions form the scalar bounds source scope.

t04.rationale: Defines intersection_update and the item-to-index rebuild helper; these definitions form the variadic mutation source scope.

t05.rationale: Padding boundary validation and mode dispatch are implemented in the defining routine.

t06.rationale: Separator emission and split-limit state live in the defining routine.

t11.rationale: Bulk loading chooses caller buffers and invokes the sorter; copying those buffers belongs at this API boundary.

t12.rationale: Balance checking and recursive subtree-height calculation live together in the utility implementation.

t07.rationale: swap is implemented here; numeric-index validation must precede every read or write.

t08.rationale: The mutable collection API and its membership-based union/difference operations are defined here.

t09.rationale: safeTry advances its sync/async generator here and currently omits closing early-yielding iterators.

t10.rationale: ResultAsync owns promise-backed unwrapOr and the new deferred fallback method belongs in that class.
